_comment: The shared repo list (issue 1067): every working clone a local build carries, and the anchor PC.
Read through Read-RepoList in lib/manifest.ps1, never parsed anywhere else. Its readers are
(one ~/.claude.json trust record per row). Read from the claude-dotfiles checkout; pull does not
anchor: the computer name of the one PC that runs the master watchdog and the desktop routines.
repos[]: repo = GitHub slug; path = clone path relative to the user's home, '/' separated;
served = the master watchdog launches a master for it. A served row also carries master (the
watchdog's --remote-control master-<name> and its -Only name), stateIssue (its 'Master orchestrator
state' issue in surreptakos/claude-dotfiles) and priority (1 is drained first: the watchdog serves
priority 1 until its state issue says nothing is left, then priority 2, and so on - Dan,
2026-09-30). An unserved row may keep master and stateIssue: the watchdog never launches it but
still closes a master of that name when its pass completes.
Seeded from the 12 clones on DAN-INSPIRON15, 2026-09-30.
